reviews.text: Great and flexible service, even for a fearful dog. I recommend it.

Once again, I had to make a "jump to the side", that is, I understood again why I should return to Koiraväen Pesu & Leikkaus - here they really understand how to groom a dog! A tough 3 hours for a dog, but how satisfied a dog can be after their care! 😊 …
Excellent experience and value for money! My 11 month old Jack Russell went in for a trim - very careful work and the dog looked quite happy after the trim! We will come again :)
The first trim goes pretty well, thanks to the Koiraväe team!
